load_passages_from_jsonl: load passages from JSONL files in a distributed manner across multiple workers with optional max load limit
save_embeddings_and_index: save embeddings and index files to disk using the provided index object and argparse options
load_or_initialize_index_flat: initialize a new flat DistributedIndex or load an existing one from disk using argparse options
load_or_initialize_index_faiss: initialize a new FAISS index with specified type and code size or load an existing one from disk
review_load_or_initialize_index: review the load_or_initialize_index function to understand how it handles flat and FAISS index modes
